lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 8 distinct high-contrast white vertical lines are visible on the primary torso. Spacing is widest at the mid-torso and decreases significantly toward the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first anterior line near the shoulder and the final two posterior lines on the rump are significantly shortened, terminating before the ventral midline.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Two distinct high-contrast circular spots are visible on the lower posterior haunch, aligned vertically.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns exhibit a lyrate trajectory, initially diverging laterally and posteriorly before curving medially and concluding with a vertical dorsal orientation at the tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The distance between the apical tips is approximately 1.5 times the width of the skull at the horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The high-contrast ivory-colored tips represent approximately 15% of the total visible horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible white chevron between the orbital regions, two white spots on the lower mandible/cheek area, a white dorsal mane, and distinct black-to-tan gradient transitions on the lower limbs.
